delivered.binder: receipts = applicationReceipts ?? registry.applicationReceipts composes CampaignApplicationConnection. Host AdvanceDay intent, auto-approved AdvanceDay proposal and GM approval of a pending AdvanceDay proposal: with entry.launch, commitGuardedProgression prepares the P2CB view outside SQL and calls host.applyHostIntentWithControls; its guard (inside the append IMMEDIATE transaction on C) refuses an invalid proposal reservation, a store without reserveMatchProgression, or a non-ready preparation, then takes the M reservation (any throw -> typed refusal progression-reservation-busy), revalidates on the exact C handle and releases M on its refusal return; onCommitted consumes the proposal then releases M in the commit span; afterRelease releases idempotently. All refusals live in the guard so a duplicate replays first. A refused outcome or the gate late refusal is answered CAMPAIGN_NOT_CONVERGED with the existing correlation id (intentId field) and a kebab-case reason only. Without entry.launch the legacy session gate is unchanged
delivered.arbiter: submitProposal/decide take an optional guarded commit used only for AdvanceDay. One attempt per pending approval: concurrent approvals share it (its late refusal, else null = duplicate). The pending entry, its original timer and deadline stay until the commit consumes them in the commit span; timeout/veto/close make valid() false so the guard refuses before any write and the approval returns null; a late refusal keeps a still-valid entry and throws the gate late refusal; answered/lost-race consume like legacy; commit-uncertain/unsettled consume and rethrow (never a fresh attempt)
